annotations.text:
Five picks out of thirty ideas, drawn against the real signal tokens.
Everything here runs on data the console already collects.
The safety state is drawn, not bolted on later: no fuzzy prefix ever resolves to a verb that merges or destroys.
This is where invariant 6 lives. Today it renders as a raw error string.
Cheapest of the five, and the one you would notice on the first morning after a night away.
Read-only by construction. The first touch is spent waking it, so a blind tap cannot land on a button underneath.
